title: Explain L00-N10657 both sides for marin-neuron-hunt
description:
Stationhouse task marin-explain-neuron, claimed 2026-10-27 (shared: spektordylan, stationhouse). Neuron pick recorded per evidence rule.

CHOSEN: L00-N10657 via sort A = pos_q99 - neg_q99 (side separation) descending over fineweb-10m-sparse summaries/pole_stats.parquet (1,769,472 rows; L00 subset 27,648). N10657: sep=0.7132, pos_q99=0.9822, neg_q99=0.2690, frac_pos=0.999952, max=1.0938, min=-0.3340. Also ranks #2 under rejected sort C, so the choice is robust.

REJECTED alt B (balanced sides, |frac_pos-0.5| asc): winner N9222 frac_pos=0.499996 but sep=-0.0042 (pos_q99 0.0237 vs neg_q99 0.0279) - tails indistinguishable, no polarity story; top-5 all sep in [-0.0065, 0.0101].
REJECTED alt C (scale_abs_p999 desc): winner N21158 scale_abs_p999=0.316 but frac_pos=0.0102, max=0.095, min=-2.25 - one rare huge negative excursion, positive side nearly silent (pos_q99=0.0328); magnitude not interpretability. N10657 was #2 here (scale_abs_p999=1.0650).

Rationale: N10657 fires positive on 99.995% of the 9,995,501 L00 tokens with a clean positive tail, and has a rare (~450 token) but real negative tail - both sides explainable, negative side distinctive.

comments.author: dawn
